data.split: 90/10 stratified official training split; original test unchanged; seed42
data.preprocessing: Headers/footers/quotes removed. TF-IDF vocabulary, 128D SVD and scaler fit on training only.
data.protocol: Inductive class-relevance retrieval. Training observations alone form the gallery; validation/test queries are disjoint. Primary Recall@1 (same-label hit); secondary class-relevance NDCG@10. Training uses class proxies, evaluation retrieves observations.

protocol.selection: Complete all 30 configs for the dataset, select each method by final validation metric, then evaluate only the selected checkpoints on test.
protocol.initialization: Identical seed42; K-dependent Lorentz homothety as in the optimizer.
protocol.dimensionality: 4 factors x 2 intrinsic dimensions; Euclidean control has 8 dimensions.
protocol.calibration: Every method learns the same score bias and temperature; temperature constrained to exp([-3,3]).
protocol.known_limitations: Single seed. These are compact custom protocols, not reproductions of published benchmark scores; common canonical cap permits curvature-dependent physical radius.
